# Publishing — 0107 What happens when you type a URL?

<!-- Generated by tools/build-projects.mjs from the Publish and Sources tabs. -->

## Title

WHERE DOES A URL GO?

## Caption (Instagram)

```
Six words, and a site appears. Your browser looks the name up in DNS, connects, locks it with HTTPS, asks for the page, then builds it from HTML, CSS, JavaScript and images. A failed image is why a page looks broken.
```

Length: 216 characters.

## YouTube Shorts

**Title:** What happens when you type a URL?

**Description:**

```
Six words, and a site appears. Your browser looks the name up in DNS, connects, locks it with HTTPS, asks for the page, then builds it from HTML, CSS, JavaScript and images. A failed image is why a page looks broken.

Sources:
- The browser asks DNS for the real address of the server the site lives on. (How the web works (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_the_web_works checked 2026-10-29
- DNS matches a name you type to the IP address the browser needs. (What is DNS? (Cloudflare Learning Center)) https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/dns/what-is-dns/ checked 2026-10-29
- DNS behaves like an address book for websites. (How the web works (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_the_web_works checked 2026-10-29
- Looking a name up is like looking up a contact before you call. (What is DNS? (Cloudflare Learning Center)) https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/dns/what-is-dns/ checked 2026-10-29
- The browser then sends an HTTP request to that server, over the connection, using TCP/IP. (How the web works (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_the_web_works checked 2026-10-29
- HTTPS is HTTP with encryption between the client and the server. (HTTPS - Glossary (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/HTTPS checked 2026-10-29
- The reply is usually a bundle: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and media files. (How browsers load websites (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_browsers_load_websites checked 2026-10-29
- The browser assembles the received files into the page: that process is rendering. (How browsers load websites (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_browsers_load_websites checked 2026-10-29
- Parsing HTML triggers further requests for stylesheets, scripts and media. (How browsers load websites (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_browsers_load_websites checked 2026-10-29
- A page can be missing a tile and still show: the pieces arrive separately. (How the web works (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Web_standards/How_the_web_works checked 2026-10-29
```
